basic_info.description: Spectacular and semi-detached, two-bedroom, one and a half bath top floor flat with significant finishes, sweeping southern views and on the border of two special neighborhoods: Bernal Heights and Glen Park! The home opens to gorgeous wood floors, two spacious bedrooms with views, both showered with natural light and have ample closet space, a full bathroom, a half-bathroom, and a conveniently located laundry closet. The heart of the home is the large gourmet kitchen and living/dining area that showcases the coveted open floor plan with breath-taking views. The building has undergone substantial improvements to the systems and there are too many upgrades to list. There is a common yard space and individual storage space that add the final touches to this flat that is close to shopping, cafes, restaurants, parks, playgrounds, Muni, Bart, HWY 101/280 and more!
